C0141.title: Man Reselling Game Accounts Leads to a 30-Million-Yuan Case
C0141.summary: Qufu police in Shandong investigated a case involving theft of game accounts and virtual equipment, with the amount involved exceeding 30 million yuan. Reports show the criminal chain illegally obtained game accounts and virtual equipment and resold them through card-issuing platforms, account rental platforms, and other channels for profit, prompting a police crackdown.
